words.example: The vendor's answer may be sitting in the junk mail folder.
words.exampleZh: 供应商的回复可能在垃圾邮件文件夹里。

words.example: Recall the mail now, before staff across the clinic open it.
words.exampleZh: 现在就撤回这封邮件，别等门诊各处的人打开它。

words.example: There is an unsubscribe link at the bottom of that vendor newsletter.
words.exampleZh: 那份供应商通讯的最下方有退订链接。

words.example: Flag anything from the director so the team answers those mails first.
words.exampleZh: 请把主任的来信标旗，让大家优先回复。

words.example: Pin this roster notice and leave it at the top of the shared inbox.
words.exampleZh: 请把这份排班通知置顶，留在共享收件箱的最上面。

words.example: Our MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) ties the three city campuses on hospital fiber.
words.exampleZh: 我们的 MAN（城域网）用医院自己的光纤把市区三个院区连起来。

words.meaning: 多协议标签交换（Multiprotocol Label Switching）
words.example: MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) carries the east campus traffic separate from internet.
words.exampleZh: MPLS（多协议标签交换）把东院区业务和上网流量分开承载。

words.meaning: 软件定义广域网（Software-Defined Wide Area Network）
words.example: SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network) moved clinic traffic to the backup circuit at noon.
words.exampleZh: 中午 SD-WAN（软件定义广域网）把门诊流量切到了备用专线。

words.example: The dark fiber between the two campuses is ours, and the carrier only lights the path.
words.exampleZh: 两院区之间的裸光纤是我们的，运营商只负责把光打通。

words.example: The last mile to the clinic annex is copper, and it fails whenever it rains.
words.exampleZh: 到门诊附楼的最后一公里还是铜缆，一下雨就出故障。
